summary: Aurelion Inc., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that Ms. Jackie You's term as an independent director expired on October 29, 2026, per the terms of her appointment, and she consequently ceased serving on the board and its committees. No price, stake, or transaction terms are stated. The board thanked Ms. You and said it is identifying a suitable candidate to fill the vacancy. This is a scheduled, term-driven departure rather than a forced or abrupt exit, so it is not a management-change event. Watch for the timing and identity of a replacement director and any committee reconstitution; no deal or arbitrage angle exists.
